about: Sukrara's Connect IQ apps, the one registry the phone (Android :integrations GarminApp, GarminAppsTest) and the watch builds (apps/garmin manifests and fetch paths, checked by apps/garmin/tools/link_cases.py --check; build.sh reads the beta ids from here) are tested against. Each app has its own Connect IQ app id (storage and phone messages are per app id, README 'Profiles'), a beta id (a Connect IQ beta app needs its own id; docs/20-publishing.md), the payload profile it gets and the path of its 5-minute fetch on 127.0.0.1:<port>. Every watch face (type watchface) gets the one face profile and fetches sukrara/face: a new face is one more entry here; there is one watch app and one data field. The phone pushes to the public and the beta id alike, whichever Garmin Connect says is installed. 'logs' = it writes entries, their undo and mutes (POST <entries>, POST <undo>, POST <mute>). 'manifest' = where its manifest lives (an app not built yet is a pending file). 'store' = its Connect IQ store listing's id (the last part of https://apps.garmin.com/<locale>/apps/<store>): Garmin gives it when the listing is published, and it isn't the app id; null until then, and while it is null the phone opens the store's search for Sukrara instead (its Garmin page and setup) and the website says Coming soon. Issue #247 fills them in.
